citation: Sharer, Robert J., with Loa P. Traxler. 2006. The Ancient Maya. 6th ed. Stanford, Calif.: Stanford University Press. Cloth ISBN 0-8047-4816-0; paperback ISBN 0-8047-4817-9 (978-0-8047-4817-9). Publisher listing also notes October 2005 / 984 pages for the 6th edition release.
notes: Standard English-language synthesis of ancient Maya civilization. Stanford UP book description (accessed 2026-10-11): traces evolution through the Pre-Columbian era, a span of some 2,500 years from the origins of complex society within Mesoamerica to the Spanish Conquest in the 16th century; 6th edition extensively revised. This repository seed uses Sharer & Traxler as the long-view handbook for Maya period language; the Early Maya entry intentionally stops at Early Classic and does NOT absorb the full Classic/Postclassic encyclopedia from this volume. No invented page numbers.
